environment: Disposable Linux ARM64 Podman VM, 1 CPU, 2 GiB RAM, three native voter processes and one native proposer on loopback, local XFS; stopped and removed

observed.initialization: Three distinct test-owned absent paths were initialized by the actual init-fresh command.
observed.threeVoters: A proposer chose a canonical test value for node A.
observed.oneStateMissing: After removal of one test voter register, a higher-ballot proposal of B returned the previously chosen A value; the missing register remained absent.
observed.twoStatesMissing: After removal of a second test voter register, the proposer returned no-majority prepare 1 and exited 1; both missing registers remained absent.

limits: All voters share one VM and one filesystem. Test transport was loopback with no fleet token or topology. This is not multi-host failure isolation, authenticated or encrypted transport, crash/power-loss durability, recovery/re-enrollment, rollback prevention, production identity, model inference, gateway integration or autonomous fleet qualification.
